title: Lien Charge Rate by Life Expectancy — Term Life Insurance Accelerated Benefit
content:
**Actuarial note — Term Life Insurance.** The lien charge rate for a terminal illness advance is chosen by the physician-certified life expectancy on the approved accelerated benefit claim, using the product's acceleration discount rate (0.065 on every tier):

| Life expectancy on the claim | Lien charge rate |
|---|---|
| 3 months or less | no charge |
| 4 through 9 months | the acceleration discount rate times the life expectancy in months over 12 |
| 10 months or more | the acceleration discount rate in full |

**Worked rates (hypothetical, discount rate 0.065).**

- 3 months: no charge. 4 months: 0.065 times 4 over 12, which is about 0.02167.
- 6 months: 0.065 times 6 over 12, which is 0.0325; on an accelerated amount of 200000 the lien charge is 6500.00.
- 9 months: 0.04875. 10 months: 0.065.
